tasks.title: Persist staging cron trigger in backend/wrangler.toml
tasks.brief: Add [env.staging.triggers] crons = ["* * * * *"] to backend/wrangler.toml so scheduledWaProcess (WhatsApp bridge queue processing) keeps running on nova-rx-api-staging after future deploys. Do not change production config. Cloud tasks never deploy.
tasks.acceptance: wrangler.toml has the staging cron; existing tests pass.
